# forgebase_collection (Data Source)

Looks up a collection by name or id.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "forgebase_collection" "users" {
  name = "users"
}

output "user_fields" {
  value = [for f in data.forgebase_collection.users.fields : f.name]
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Collection name or id.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Creation time.
- `fields` (Attributes List) Fields, including system fields. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--fields))
- `id` (String) Server-assigned collection id.
- `schema_mode` (String) `strict` or `flexible`.
- `tenant_scoped` (Boolean) Rows are isolated per tenant.
- `type` (String) `base`, `auth` or `view`.
- `updated` (String) Last schema change.
- `version` (Number) Schema version.
- `versioned` (Boolean) Every record version is kept.
- `view_query` (String) SELECT of a view.
